notes.title: Beta testing has started
notes.content:
The new build for Saga of Guardians is here:

Lots and lots of changes, mostly: It looks nice now!

Aside from that we've got ranks now.
Win games and go from Bronze until the #1 Guardian

...and one more thing: We put the C in CCG, you have now your own collection that you can expand with booster packs.
Do your "daily mission", earn gold, expand your collection.

With this the game moves from "Alpha"-state to "Beta", which means your account starts over but from now on you will keep everything even into the full release of the game 🚀 

Please give it all a try and let me know any bugs you encounter or any other feedback 🙏
